tools.name: e3d_status
tools.description: Start here: check the assigned E3D version, adapter connection, running session/build, MCP mode and command permission.

tools.name: e3d_context_snapshot
tools.description: Read connection, project, MDB and current-element evidence in one bounded read-only workflow. Uses at most health -> project -> health, with no retries or polling; project is skipped unless the first health sample positively establishes native readiness and version/session/build identity. Inspect context_complete, readiness, session_coherence, evidence and errors. Busy, disconnected or unknown readiness is observed data, not permission to continue SDK reads. Matching health samples establish bracket consistency only: reads are not atomic and the project response is not directly session-bound. Missing user/current-element fields stay unknown. Never establishes future readiness, edit permission, SAVEWORK safety or an empty PML input stack. Does not read retained messages, execute commands, cancel, restart, capture or change model/view state.

tools.name: e3d_project_info
tools.description: Read the current project, MDB, and current element for this E3D version. Read-only.

tools.name: e3d_database_state
tools.description: Read the current E3D 2.1 MDB database list, native read-only/primary flags, changed-session flags and current/latest session identifiers. Limits bound returned details; the SDK still materializes the complete database array. Arrays over 10000 databases fail before detail reads. Pagination is a live observation in MDB order and can change between calls; provide the returned context_id as expected_context after the first page to bind the bridge session/project/MDB. page_complete describes requested fields, while complete requires all databases in a single successful response. Native database flags do not guarantee permission for a particular element edit or prove SAVEWORK is safe. Does not save/get work, change CE or execute PML.

expected_context.description: context_id from the first page; required with offset > 0.

tools.name: e3d_database_identity_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current E3D21 MDB database identity list in one bounded native UI callback. Returns ordered name, database number and extract identity fields plus a SHA-256 fingerprint of those fields. The scan is limited to 10000 entries and is not a database lock or project-wide catalog. Supply the context_id from e3d_database_state to bind the request to the observed E3D session, project and MDB. Does not read sessions/access flags, initialize Admin, execute PML/CMD, write or save work.

expected_context.description: context_id returned by e3d_database_state for the current E3D session/project/MDB.

tools.name: e3d_database_preflight
tools.description: Build a non-executable E3D21 CREATE DB candidate for DESI or CATA. Admin creates CATA databases for PARAGON; this tool does not specify or create a CATA root element. Inspect native readiness, project context and name/DBNO conflicts in the current MDB through read-only SDK-backed endpoints. UPDATE and MULTIWRITE are the installed Admin form's access choices; MULTIWRITE explicitly uses CLAIM IMPLICIT. CONTROLLED is a separate database flag and is not accepted as access. Complete means a bounded single-dispatch current-MDB coverage with matching boundary observations. The identity array is read in one native UI callback with a 10000-entry limit. These reads do not lock the database or verify project-wide uniqueness, Admin permission or PARAGON write access. execution_supported, creation_attempted and created are always false. Does not execute PML/CMD, initialize Admin, write, save work or change CE/view. Mock mode and versions other than E3D21 report unavailable without native calls. Opt in with include_project_catalog to look for additional positive matches in the visible SDK catalog. A missing match does not prove project-wide absence; complete still describes the current MDB check.

team.description: Single ASCII team component; normalized to uppercase. Team existence is not verified.

name.description: Single ASCII database name component; normalized to uppercase. The 32-character cap is tool policy.

database_type.description: DESI is Design; CATA is the Catalogue database type. The candidate has no initial element or WITH clause.

area.description: Zero/omitted uses the system area. Other areas are candidates only; directory availability is unverified.

include_project_catalog.description: Try a separate read-only SDK catalog probe for positive DB and team matches. Requires a supporting E3D21 Addin.

tools.name: e3d_team_database_identity_manifest
tools.description: Observe bounded typed System/Global TEAM, DBLI and DB identities and current MDB relations in E3D21 bridge mode. Supply expected_context from an earlier e3d_database_state context_id. Reads independent health once and then one manifest POST; native single_dispatch applies only to the manifest. Each SDK-visible source returns its own bounded prefix, not a stable paginated catalog. Unmatched or partial evidence remains unknown. Does not select a creation parent DBLI, establish project-wide absence, inspect Admin authorization, create databases, issue executable previews, execute PML or change models. Mock and other versions are unavailable.

expected_context.description: Exact prior e3d_database_state context_id; never automatically refreshed.

limit.description: Independent maximum for each of TEAM, system DB records and current MDB arrays.

tools.name: e3d_piping_branch_state
tools.description: Read one explicit E3D21 BRAN's native head/tail attributes, specifications, service attributes and bounded direct member identities in database order. Keeps SDK formatted text and native typed scalars when present; does not convert frames or units. Member identities contain refno, type and sibling_index to distinguish implicit TUBI from an anchor sharing its DBREF. Inspect complete, read_errors and context.boundary_agreement. Separate native reads with matching boundary observations are not an atomic snapshot. Does not run PML, infer endpoints from PPLS/PCREF, validate engineering compatibility or change the model, current element or view.

refno.description: Explicit BRAN /NAME or =database/element.

member_limit.description: Maximum direct members to return. Truncation makes the result incomplete.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_manifest
tools.description: Read one explicit EQUI root and a bounded preorder prefix of its Design members with selected formatted and typed SDK attributes in one E3D21 UI callback. Row 0 is the root; each child has a zero-based parent_index and one-based sibling_index. A depth, count or read limit makes complete=false; inspect rows, read_errors and truncation_reasons. Single dispatch does not mean an atomic database snapshot. No PML, model writes or view changes. Requires an Addin exposing equipment_manifest.

refno.description: Explicit EQUI /NAME or =database/element.

limit.description: Maximum rows including the root; limit multiplied by attribute count cannot exceed 500.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_child_schema
tools.description: Read three independent E3D21 SDK evidence scopes in one UI callback: the explicit existing Design parent's IsCreatable observation for the requested type; that type's SystemAttributes metadata; and optional explicit existing read-target attribute support/settable observations only when its actual SDK type matches the requested type, including UDETs. The read target is an exemplar and need not be a child of the parent; no ownership relationship is asserted. Without a read target, instance attributes remain unknown while parent/type evidence may be returned. Type SystemAttributes are not future-instance attributes. SDK arrays materialize before paging; pages and the 4096-entry inspection cutoff are not hard SDK memory limits. At most 20 explicit exemplar attributes and 200 type metadata rows per page are returned. This is read-only evidence, not a creation preview, permission/revision check, proposed-value validation, constraint observation, or engineering validation. Inspect partial read errors and session/build/project/MDB/typed CE boundaries. No model or CE changes.

parent_refno.description: Explicit existing Design /NAME or =database/element; trimmed reference is at most 256 characters. No CE or wildcards.

element_type.description: Explicit SDK type name, including the colon for a UDET; trimmed and uppercased.

read_target_refno.description: Optional explicit existing Design exemplar, with the same reference rules as parent_refno. Does not establish parent/child ownership.

attributes.description: 0 to 20 explicit existing-target SDK attribute names, unique after trimming and uppercasing; never future child attributes.

tools.name: e3d_pipe_member_manifest
tools.description: Read a bounded database preorder prefix beneath one explicit E3D21 Design PIPE or BRAN in one native UI callback. Root is ID 0; each member has a typed DBREF, native name, depth, parent_index and sibling_index. An implicit TUBI can share its DBREF with a distinct component. Keeps SDK formatted attributes and scalar values when present; inspect unavailable_attributes, row errors, traversal_complete, truncation_reasons and context.boundary_agreement. complete describes this bounded observation, not an atomic snapshot, connectivity or engineering validation. No PML, model or view changes. Requires a supporting E3D21 Addin.

refno.description: Explicit PIPE or BRAN /NAME or =database/element.

limit.description: Maximum member rows, excluding the root. limit times attribute count cannot exceed 500.

attributes.description: SDK attribute names for every member. An empty array reads identities only.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_model_plan
tools.description: Build a read-only, bounded plan for up to 16 explicit create, copy or transform steps under one EQUI. Reads one complete equipment manifest, native parent/target schemas, optional same-type attribute constraints, WORLD poses and frame conversions, bracketed by fresh context snapshots. Inspect status, context_consistency, step parent paths, constraints, unknowns and write_steps. A ready result is not a native edit preview or engineering approval. Create/copy revisions are obtained only by a later dry_run on their existing write tools. e3d_set_transform has no revision guard. This tool never calls create/copy/transform write routes, PML, selection, display or capture.

equipment_refno.description: Explicit EQUI /NAME or DBREF; the complete bounded manifest root.

parent_refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element; must resolve inside the supplied EQUI manifest where noted.

target_refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element; must resolve inside the supplied EQUI manifest where noted.

source_refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element; must resolve inside the supplied EQUI manifest where noted.

attribute_reference_refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element; must resolve inside the supplied EQUI manifest where noted.

tools.name: e3d_piping_route_plan
tools.description: Build a read-only plan for an explicit PIPE or BRAN. Reads the bounded member manifest, each observed BRAN state, actual typed member P-points, optional explicit endpoint P-points and PCREF traces, and schema candidates for existing same-type elements. Returns a proposed ordered create_element/set_attributes dry-run sequence only; every revision is null and no create/set preview or write is called. Cross-request reads are live, non-atomic observations; missing or changed session/project/MDB/CE context remains unknown. Schema and connection evidence do not validate proposed values, geometry, routing, catalogue compatibility or engineering suitability.

root_refno.description: One explicit Design PIPE or BRAN /NAME or =database/element.

parent_index.description: Optional earlier planned member index; omission means root_refno.

set_attributes.description: Set attributes after creation. NAME is excluded; use the planned member name field.

tools.name: e3d_paragon_catalogue_manifest
tools.description: Read a bounded native preorder manifest beneath an explicit E3D21 Catalogue /NAME or =database/element in one UI callback. limit includes root ID 0; depth is measured from that root. Rows retain native base type, NAME, typed owner, parent_index and native Member sibling_index, SDK formatted attributes and scalar values. Inspect unavailable_attributes, row errors, traversal_complete, truncation_reasons and before/after session/build/project/MDB/typed CE evidence. Unknown context stays unknown. complete concerns only this bounded observation; Admin database creation, PARAGON permissions, current module and engineering validity are unverified. No PML, CE selection, module switch or model writes. Requires a supporting E3D21 Addin.

refno.description: One explicit literal Catalogue /NAME or =database/element; never CE or a wildcard.

limit.description: Maximum rows including the root; limit times attribute count must not exceed 500.

attributes.description: Explicit SDK attribute names. Empty reads native identities and hierarchy only.

tools.name: e3d_module_context
tools.description: Read the active E3D21 module name, number and description in one UI-thread observation with before/after session, bridge build, project/user, optional MDB and typed current element evidence. A missing module, project, MDB or CE is reported separately from an unknown getter result. Module identity does not grant Admin database creation or PARAGON write permission; both remain unknown. This does not assess a database lock, initialize Admin, switch modules, access the model database or change CE. Requires E3D21 bridge mode.

tools.name: e3d_paragon_catalogue_schema
tools.description: Inspect one explicit current E3D21 Catalogue parent in one UI callback. Returns native base-type MemberTypes, their raw DbType codes and parent IsCreatable observations, capped at 200 member types and 32 database codes per type. `sdk_creatable_now` only records the current parent's SDK state; it does not authorize PARAGON NEW or establish complete creation validation. Explicit attributes and optional SDK allowed values/descriptions, raw ranges and values-or-ranges optionality concern only this current target; future child attributes, proposed values, permissions and engineering rules remain unverified. Constraints are capped at 100 values/boundaries per attribute and 1024 UTF-16 characters per text. The result sets `future_child_attributes_observed=false`. Native arrays are already materialized before output limits apply. Inspect errors and session/build/project/MDB/typed CE boundaries. No model or CE changes.

refno.description: Explicit Catalogue /NAME or =database/element reference; never CE or wildcards.

attributes.description: SDK metadata on the explicit current target. Empty reads member types only.

include_constraints.description: Requires 1 to 10 explicit current-target attributes. Not future child attributes.

tools.name: e3d_paragon_component_template
tools.description: Read bounded native evidence for one existing Catalogue SCOM in E3D21. Observe its typed identity, first member, up to 128 numeric PARAM items, and up to 16 one-hop identity items per fixed reference attribute. The SDK materializes native arrays before the output bounds and the 4096-item inspection cutoff. Project, MDB and typed current element are compared at both boundaries of the read. Completeness covers this scope. Word parameters, reference contents, engineering validation and a complete clone fingerprint remain outside it.

refno.description: Canonical numeric =database/element for one existing Catalogue SCOM.

tools.name: e3d_paragon_generation_plan
tools.description: Compose one review draft for copying an existing SCOM leaf within the same explicit Catalogue CATE. The user configures the existing Catalogue database through ADMIN. Reads health, PARAGON module 81 identity, source specification, component-template actual type and bounded numeric PARAM evidence, parent specification and parent schema; retains all six raw receipts. Requires observed native base and actual SCOM identity and complete finite numeric PARAM coverage for a two-line PML draft and an unsubmitted dry_run=true script request only with sufficient observations. No PML preview or execution is submitted. Module 81 is identity, not permission. Word parameters, complete clone identity, runtime grammar/copy semantics, geometry/reference equivalence and units remain unverified; execution_ready is always false. Does not create a DB/CATE, select CE, deploy, save, claim, change parameters or automatically retry.

source_refno.description: Canonical numeric source SCOM leaf; Int32 pairs only.

parent_refno.description: Explicit numeric Catalogue CATE; must be the source's actual typed owner.

name.description: ASCII /NAME; no double or terminal slash, whitespace, dot, quotes, commands or wildcards.

tools.name: e3d_piping_connectivity_snapshot
tools.description: Read a bounded batch of explicit E3D21 BRAN states, typed P-point pairs and one directed PCREF trace in one native UI callback. Each item keeps read coverage and session/build/project/MDB/typed-CE binding. max_nodes counts trace endpoint inspections, including alias resolutions; pair endpoints and branch members have independent disclosed bounds. Starts are hop 0. No traversal between component P-points, geometric edges or engineering connectivity/compatibility verdict is inferred. Inspect report, each complete flag, read_errors and truncated; one callback is not a database lock.

tools.name: e3d_piping_specification_read
tools.description: Read bounded raw/typed SDK observations for one explicit numeric E3D21 REF, native expected_type and database_type. Keep independent formatted/typed statuses, per-field errors, typed owners and one-hop reference identities. Units remain unknown; complete covers only requested observations, bounded ownership traversal and matching session/build/project/MDB/typed CE boundaries. No compatibility check, automatic selection, PML or model changes. Requires a reviewed native route and envelope/fault transport contract.

refno.description: Explicit numeric =database/element; names, CE, patterns and inferred aliases are excluded.

expected_type.description: Explicit native SDK type ShortName; a shared BRAN/TUBI REF does not infer an alias.

database_type.description: Explicit native database type, independent of the numeric REF database number.

limit.description: Rows including root; limit times attribute count must be at most 500.

attributes.description: Explicit SDK attribute names; empty requests identities only.

tools.name: e3d_spatial_map_status
tools.description: Resolve one explicit Design database in the current E3D21 MDB. Native CheckSpatialMap is temporarily suspended following a verified E3D21 stack-overflow crash on 2026-11-16. An otherwise valid request returns native_spatial_map_check_suspended, check_attempted=false, check_completed=false and status=null; metadata may still be available. Do not substitute PML MAP CHECK or MAP BUILD to bypass this suspension. First use e3d_database_state to obtain database_number (its number), extract_number and context_id; pass context_id as expected_context to bind the session/project/MDB. Inspect check attempted/completed, status, its raw integer value, complete and errors; failed or unavailable fields remain null. NOWARNINGS is not equivalent to UPTODATE, does not necessarily mean damage, and no status proves geometry correctness or complete clash coverage. The SDK resolves CheckSpatialMap by database number only: extract databases and ambiguity from multiple extracts of the same number are rejected before Check. A primary database with extract_number=1 can be resolved; use native IsExtract rather than assuming every nonzero extract_number is an extract database. This read-only tool preserves native status and query messages, does not BuildSpatialMap, write model geometry, execute PML or capture images, and requires no command permission. The native query can emit diagnostics or affect internal diagnostic caches; read-only does not certify diagnostic-state invariance. Only E3D21 implements this tool; mock and other versions return explicit unavailability.

database_number.description: number from e3d_database_state for a Design DB in the current MDB.

extract_number.description: Exact extract_number from the same database-state row; nonzero does not imply IsExtract=true.

expected_context.description: Optional context_id from e3d_database_state; empty omits this context guard.

tools.name: e3d_query
tools.description: Look up a direct reference or perform the legacy bounded global type/name lookup. Global results do not certify complete coverage or provide continuation. Use e3d_find_descendants for a scoped paged search with explicit completeness and read errors.

expression.description: E3D query/refno expression, for example /SITE/PIPE-001 or PIPE

tools.name: e3d_read_logs
tools.description: Read recent E3D adapter diagnostics. The adapter controls which log source is exposed.

tools.name: e3d_read_messages
tools.description: Read recent AVEVA internal message events captured inside the E3D Addin, including command errors that may otherwise appear in an E3D dialog.

tools.name: e3d_read_message_window
tools.description: Read a session-bound, authenticated cursor window of captured E3D output in one managed-only request. Requires an E3D21 adapter advertising message_cursor_v1; an older tail response is never substituted. First call without a cursor reads the oldest retained output after sequence zero. Use checkpoint=true without a cursor to capture the current sequence without returning historical messages, then pass the returned next_cursor unchanged to collect subsequent output. Positions and overwrite counts are decimal strings to preserve Int64 precision. has_more/remaining_count describe pagination; overwritten_count describes messages already lost from the 500-entry ring. Empty output does not mean no error occurred. Cursor/session mismatch or future positions fail explicitly; do not silently reset the cursor. The window covers captured output only and never establishes command causation, database readiness or absence of faults. Does not use health, UI dispatch, SDK database reads, PML, cancellation, retries, capture, or model/view changes, including its native error path. Captured text may include PML output.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by this adapter session; pass unchanged.

checkpoint.description: Capture the current position with no messages; cannot combine with a nonempty cursor.

tools.name: e3d_command_state
tools.description: Read whether the E3D Addin is busy executing a command or waiting on a dialog.

tools.name: e3d_cancel_command
tools.description: Cancel an E3D command or dialog through E3D's internal CIE cancel event, prompt restoration, and modal-dialog recovery. This is intended for recovery when a command is waiting for input.

tools.name: e3d_drawlist_snapshot
tools.description: Read the active E3D Drawlist and each top-level member's display properties.

tools.name: e3d_fit_view
tools.description: Fit the current E3D 3D view to the active Drawlist using E3D's graphics API; by default repopulate an empty Drawlist from the current EQUI and use an isometric direction so vertical face geometry is visible. Check result.persistence separately: a successful display operation can have a failed save, and an ordinary fit does not save the Drawlist. Do not replay a successful display operation to retry persistence.

auto_add_current.description: When the Drawlist is empty, add the current EQUI hierarchy before fitting.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_view_state
tools.description: Read the active native E3D camera, including centre, direction, radius, projection and view identifiers. Does not change the camera, current element or Drawlist.

tools.name: e3d_view_clipping_state
tools.description: Read the active native E3D21 View3D clipping state, including global clipping, cap settings, SDK clip-box data and the six box-face flags. This may initialize the SDK's managed clipping cache but does not set clipping, refresh graphics, change the camera, modify the model or alter Drawlist membership. Preserve null fields, status, error_code and read_errors when clipping is unavailable, a getter fails or the view changes during the read; complete=true requires every read and view_unchanged=true. Unsupported versions report error_code=unsupported_version without contacting their bridge.

tools.name: e3d_observe_view
tools.description: Observe the actual native camera, view identity and top-level Drawlist fingerprints across separate UI callbacks. Reports stable=true/false/null, completeness and observed differences across a bounded number of samples; null means unverified. HTTP timeouts may extend elapsed time. Optional include_clipping reads native clipping after the first and final view samples and includes their three-valued comparison in stable/complete; defaults false with no clipping reads. Retains raw baseline/final clipping receipts. Getters may initialize managed caches; coordinates and units remain SDK-native and unverified. Equal samples do not establish individual plane geometry or whether a target is clipped. Stable/complete samples do not certify database readiness or absence of native faults; inspect raw health and e3d_context_snapshot before further SDK work. Does not fit, restore, select, capture or change the view. Changes may include concurrent user interaction. Does not establish future stability, primitive appearance, model revisions or pixel visibility.

include_clipping.description: Add at most two native clipping reads and retain both receipts plus an unchanged true/false/unknown comparison. No clipping reads when false.

tools.name: e3d_display_state
tools.description: Read native display ownership and properties for one explicit E3D element. Reports the SDK top-level classification, exact Drawlist membership, resolved member identity and whether it matches the requested target, plus matching existing native primitive entries and their owner references. The SDK may resolve an ancestor member. Native primitive entries are reported as observed; no matching entry does not imply no rendering. Inspect complete, primitive_scan_complete and read_errors before drawing conclusions. Does not create primitive entries, change properties, add members, refresh graphics, save state, select CE or move the camera. Pixel visibility is not verified; use e3d_capture_view for an image. Before e3d_set_drawlist_visual, verify the target is an exact top-level member: add=true does not guarantee an independent primitive member.

refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference; current element is never implicit.

tools.name: e3d_diagnose_element
tools.description: Collect bounded diagnostic evidence for one explicit E3D21 element: snapshot (depth 2, limit 100), selected attribute schema, native bounds, type-appropriate panel or primitive geometry, display ownership and sampled view/selection context. Checks readiness and session/project identity before each stage; stops on read failures and retains earlier evidence. Never substitutes an owner for the requested reference/type. Unsupported checks, truncated data and unverified coordinate frames remain unknown; workflow success is not an engineering or pixel-visibility verdict. Optional include_clipping samples native clipping before and after the diagnostic, retains both observations, and includes their three-valued comparison in observed_window_unchanged. Equal samples do not prove the target is visible, clipped or unaffected by individually defined planes; clipping coordinates and units remain SDK-native and unverified. Defaults false with no clipping reads. Optional include_image returns one native MCP PNG of the current view, which may not contain the target. Capture uses the existing graphics refresh and may process pending changes. evidence_detail defaults to full. Optional compact omits redundant successful gate/capture samples only after consistent observations, reports omissions, and keeps geometry/display evidence. Failure, drift or unverified observations retain full evidence; no native reads or image bytes are removed. Optional retain_receipt=true stores the original full evidence and any PNG before compaction. Inspect result.diagnostic_receipt: retention can fail independently of diagnosis; failed retention returns full evidence even if compact was requested. Storage is local to this MCP process, expires after 30 minutes, and has FIFO limits of 16 entries and 64 MiB of serialized metadata plus base64 image bytes. Observed view or selection changes are reported without restoration. Does not edit models, add display members, set the camera, change selection, execute PML, cancel, restart or retry. These are sequential live reads, not an atomic snapshot or a native execution-time bound. Available with a connected E3D21 bridge; mock mode reports unavailable. The same-named MCP prompt only renders guidance.

refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference; no implicit current element.

include_clipping.description: Read native clipping at baseline/final stages. Retains partial evidence and reports unchanged true/false/unknown without determining whether the target is clipped.

retain_receipt.description: Retain full historical evidence and any image in this MCP process for later lookup; no disk persistence.

evidence_detail.description: Response detail only. Compact retains full evidence on failed, changed or unverified observations.

tools.name: e3d_diagnostic_receipt
tools.description: Read the original full diagnostic evidence from a receipt_id returned by e3d_diagnose_element with retain_receipt=true, optionally including the original PNG. Uses only this MCP process's bounded memory store and never contacts E3D, refreshes graphics or repeats a diagnosis. Evidence is historical and may describe an earlier E3D session. A successful lookup is distinct from the embedded diagnostic's success. Unknown, expired, evicted or other-process IDs return available=false and status=unknown_or_expired; missing evidence does not prove non-execution. Lookup does not extend expiry.

tools.name: e3d_compare_diagnostic_receipts
tools.description: Compare two full retained diagnostic receipts in this MCP process without contacting E3D or extending retention. Requires completed diagnostic workflows with matching target reference/type, version, session/build and project/MDB/user context; names may differ. Original complete=false and unknown coverage remain visible. Returns bounded structural JSON differences for target, snapshot, schema, bounds, geometry, display, baseline/final view and selection, and image metadata. Baseline/final clipping sections are included only when either receipt requested clipping or contains clipping evidence. Dictionary key order is ignored; array order and boolean/integer/float types are significant. Missing stages are unknown, not model deletions. Inspect compatibility, sections, traversal_complete, truncated and original diagnostic summaries. Difference values may be bounded previews. Caller labels before/after do not establish chronology or causation. A same-ID comparison is only self-comparison. No tolerance, coordinate conversion, engineering verdict, visibility verdict or fresh screenshot is inferred; use e3d_diagnostic_receipt to retrieve original full evidence and PNG.

tools.name: e3d_display_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current native display maps, including top-level members and their existing primitive entries. Takes no arguments and does not change the view, current element or saved state. Preserve and inspect complete, errors and nullable observations; partial reads do not prove absence. One database reference may have entries under multiple owner members. Observed visual properties do not prove override masks or pixel visibility, and observation hashes are not write revisions. Use e3d_set_primitive_visual preview to obtain a revision bound to a specific change request.

tools.name: e3d_set_primitive_visual
tools.description: Preview or update colour, transparency, edges, visibility or shallow on existing native primitive entries for an explicit reference. Native eligibility requires non-TOPF and PRMF; all owner aliases for that database reference are verified across the complete display maps. Never Add members, create primitive entries or substitute an ancestor as the requested target. Restoring transparency to 0 may use the public aggregate setter on the SDK-resolved member, then compensate all existing primitive values and verify that member values and all other primitive values are unchanged. Inspect transparency_reset_members and setter_attempts entries prefixed member_visual_properties: for attempted aggregate resets; those fields alone do not prove success. If the resolved member must finish nonzero while a primitive needs restoration to 0, both preview and execution reject before writing. At least one nonempty colour, transparency or non-null boolean is required; omitted/empty colour and null booleans preserve their current values. Preview defaults to true and returns a revision bound to the target, requested changes, session/context and complete display state. Execute the same changes with that preview revision as expected_revision and command permission. Read actual rollback/residual diagnostics after failure; only the five observed visual values are verified, not override masks or pixel visibility. Do not automatically replay uncertain writes.

refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference; never an implicit current element or ancestor.

expected_revision.description: Revision from the preview of the same target and visual changes; required for execution.

colour.description: Native colour name or index; omitted, empty or whitespace-only preserves the current colour.

shallow.description: Native on-top transient rendering; null preserves the current value. Does not control descendant inclusion.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_remove_drawlist_member
tools.description: Preview or remove one explicitly named native top-level member from the current E3D Drawlist using the public SDK. This removes display membership, not database geometry; it does not execute PML or substitute an ancestor for a primitive. Requires complete display observations and rejects overlapping displayed ancestors/descendants, crossing primitive aliases, or graphical selections overlapping the target. Inspect the rejection; selection changes must be explicit via e3d_set_graphical_selection. Preview defaults to true and returns a revision bound to the request, target identity, bridge instance, project/MDB, Drawlist, camera, current element, full display maps and ordered graphical selection. Execute the same refno with that revision and command permission. An already absent eligible top-level member is a verified no-op, not proof of pixel invisibility. Success verifies the target database identity still exists, all remaining member/primitive observations, camera, CE and selection. A native removal is dispatched at most once. Failure reports actual residuals without automatically re-adding or replaying; inspect outcome_uncertain and do not resend uncertain writes. Persistence status is separate from verified removal. Use capture_after for a native image; pixel visibility is not inferred from membership alone.

refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference for the exact top-level display member.

expected_revision.description: Revision from a current removal preview with the same refno; required for execution.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_set_view
tools.description: Explicitly set a native E3D camera preset and optionally fit the existing Drawlist or one target's geometry bounds. Axis presets specify the native looking direction; isometric looks along normalized [1,1,-1]. A non-keep preset selects orthographic projection with zero twist. Preview defaults to true; execution requires command permission. Never adds elements, restores a saved view or selects a current element. A target must already be visible through the Drawlist for a useful image receipt.

target_refno.description: Required only for fit=target; /NAME or =database/element resolved by the SDK.

padding.description: Fit radius multiplier, used when fit is drawlist or target.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_set_camera
tools.description: Preview or set five explicit native E3D camera fields: centre, looking direction, radius, perspective and extra twist. Use values from e3d_view_state to return to a previously observed pose, with native floating-point readback tolerance. All five fields are required; coordinates use the SDK native frame and direction is normalized by the adapter. This does not restore other optics, clipping, viewport size or shading settings. Preview defaults to true; execute the same request with the preview revision as expected_revision and command permission. The revision binds the requested values, current camera and viewport, bridge instance, project/MDB, view, Drawlist, full display maps, CE and ordered graphical selection. State changes require a fresh preview. A camera already matching within readback tolerance skips camera setters and MapView. A real write maps once, then verifies camera readback, shading, display, selection and CE; failures preserve observed residuals without automatic retry or rollback. Never replay an uncertain write. Does not add graphics, fit geometry, select CE or save Drawlist state. capture_after returns a native picture and requested/readback camera agreement at bitmap time.

centre.description: Three finite SDK native coordinates, within the readable single-precision range.

direction.description: Finite nonzero native looking vector; the adapter normalizes its length.

extra_twist_degrees.description: Finite native additional camera twist in degrees.

expected_revision.description: Fresh revision from the same five-field preview; required for execution.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_restore_view
tools.description: Explicitly reload the saved E3D Drawlist and available display properties after a restart when view restoration is requested. Changes view membership; startup does not restore it automatically. Primitive transparency 0 can require a public aggregate reset of its resolved member, compensation of all existing primitive values and full-map verification; inspect transparency_reset_members. Schema-2 restoration rejects before setters when primitive transparency must become 0 but the resolved member must finish nonzero, or when member transparency must become 100 and its individual setter would clamp to 99. Check actual rollback/residual diagnostics on failure and result.persistence separately from restore readiness: a successful restore can have a failed save. A save failure does not replay the restore or prevent an optional native image receipt.

fit.description: Fit the 3D view after the saved elements are loaded.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_set_drawlist_visual
tools.description: Set color, edges, visibility, transparency, or shallow rendering on an exact top-level E3D Drawlist member, optionally requesting Add first. Use e3d_display_state to inspect a primitive's actual display owner before writing. Add does not guarantee the requested primitive becomes an independent top-level member; an ancestor resolved by the SDK is not an exact target match. Preview and execution reject a change to member transparency 100 before writing because the individual setter clamps to 99; an already-matching value can remain unchanged. They also reject a nonzero final resolved-member transparency when preserving a primitive requires restoring its transparency to 0. Otherwise zero restoration may use a public aggregate member reset plus compensation and verification of all existing primitive values; inspect transparency_reset_members and actual rollback/residual diagnostics. Success requires other member and primitive values to remain unchanged. Empty colour preserves the current colour; a nonempty value must resolve to a native colour in preview and execution before any Add or setter. Native shallow means on-top transient rendering regenerated every frame; it does not limit descendant inclusion. Drawlist membership and display settings do not prove pixel visibility. Check result.persistence separately: a failed save preserves the successful display operation and remains eligible for an optional native image receipt. Do not replay the display operation to retry persistence or a rejected Add.

shallow.description: Native on-top transient rendering: regenerated every frame without cached graphics. Does not control whether descendants are included; null preserves the current setting.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_element_snapshot
tools.description: Read an E3D hierarchy. expected_type uses the SDK type ShortName and requires the resolved type to match; the only cross-type exception is implicit TUBI sharing a numeric DBREF with its BRAN/ELBO anchor. Other mismatches fail. limit caps the total nodes including the root. snapshot_info reports omitted descendants, depth/limit truncation, and read errors.

expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName, e.g. TUBI. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO numeric DBREF; other mismatches fail.

tools.name: e3d_list_members
tools.description: Read one page of direct children in database order through bounded SDK member indexes. Pass next_cursor unchanged to continue; omit refno when continuing or use the same parent. expected_type uses the SDK type ShortName and requires the resolved parent type to match; the only cross-type exception is implicit TUBI sharing a numeric DBREF with its BRAN/ELBO anchor. The cursor retains that type and sibling index. Members include sibling_index so same-refno objects remain distinct. Cursors expire on E3D restart or project/MDB change. This is a live listing: edits between pages can invalidate the cursor. Inspect has_more and read_errors; null has_more means the page failed.

refno.description: Parent /NAME or =database/element. Empty starts at the current element, or continues the parent encoded in cursor.

expected_type.description: Optional required parent type ShortName. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO anchor; omitted continuation inherits the cursor type.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the previous page. Start with an empty cursor.

tools.name: e3d_find_descendants
tools.description: Search descendants under one explicit root, excluding the root itself. Filter by exact native element type and/or literal case-insensitive name text. Pages visit at most 1000 candidates and return at most limit matches; empty pages can still have has_more=true. Follow next_cursor until has_more=false, then inspect scope_complete, complete, depth_truncated and read_errors. Cursors bind the E3D session, project, root and filters; omitted filters/depth inherit the cursor. This is a live traversal, not an immutable snapshot: concurrent model edits can change results. Does not execute PML, select CE or alter the view.

root_refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element required on the first page; may be omitted with cursor.

element_type.description: Exact SDK base type such as NCYL or PANE. Empty matches all types; omitted inherits cursor or defaults to empty on the first page.

name_contains.description: Literal case-insensitive substring, not a regular expression or PML. Omitted inherits cursor or defaults to empty on the first page.

max_depth.description: Direct children are depth 1. Defaults to 64 on the first page; omitted inherits cursor. Depth omissions set complete=false even when scope_complete=true.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor, returned unchanged. Expired, altered or out-of-scope cursors fail explicitly.

tools.name: e3d_validate_model
tools.description: Check required element types and publish dimension_check_rules for BOX/NBOX, CYLI/NCYL, CONE/NCON and DISH in one E3D UI dispatch. Lengths are converted from the SDK's dimensioned value to explicit millimetres; box/cylinder dimensions must be positive, a cone may have one zero end diameter but not both, and DISH permits RADI=0 under the bounded MCP policy. NOZZ.HEIG is checked while unsupported NOZZ.DIAM is listed in unverified_dimensions; ordinary read/conversion errors appear in check_read_errors and native faults stop immediately. Inspect complete, checks_complete, valid, issues and unverified fields separately; definite invalid dimensions remain false even when another read is unknown. Negative-primitive dimension validity does not prove a Boolean cut. This does not verify the complete native geometry domain, engineering design, surface topology or rendering. Set include_snapshot=false for a compact result. A single UI dispatch is not a database lock.

tools.name: e3d_read_attributes
tools.description: Read requested SDK attributes (for example POS, ORI, HEIG, OWNER, or :CUSTOM) without executing PML. expected_type requires the resolved type to match; the only cross-type alias resolution supported is implicit TUBI from its shared BRAN/ELBO numeric DBREF. The result reports the resolved type. Returns native formatted values plus typed_values for scalar numbers, strings and booleans, and per-attribute errors. Arrays and geometric values retain their native formatting; use e3d_spatial_info for explicit coordinates. Partial values are retained on error.

expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName, e.g. TUBI. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO numeric DBREF; other mismatches fail.

tools.name: e3d_read_attributes_batch
tools.description: Read the same requested SDK attributes from up to 50 explicitly referenced elements in one E3D UI-thread dispatch. Returns ordered rows with each element's refno/type/name, native formatted values, typed scalar values and per-attribute errors. The combined batch is limited to 500 element/attribute cells; duplicate refs and attributes are removed after normalization. No PML command, CE change or view change is performed. Check each row's success/errors and the top-level complete/ce_unchanged flags; partial rows are retained on read failure. One dispatch reduces inter-call drift but the response is not a durable database snapshot.

refnos.description: Unique explicit /NAME or =database/element references; current CE is never implicit.

attributes.description: Requested attribute names, such as NAME, DESC, HEIG, or POS.

tools.name: e3d_element_access
tools.description: Read current-session generic update_allowed/read_only, LOCK/DBWRIT/OKCLA/DACCLA, database identity/access flags, PRMOWN reference and target claim LCLM/LCLMH/USERC/CLMNUM/EXTRC for 1 to 32 explicit elements in one E3D UI dispatch. Each fields/database/target_claim leaf retains nullable value, status, source and source_refno. Unknown or unavailable values are not false. scan_complete means planned reads were attempted, including ordinary read errors; all_values_available requires every leaf status to be ok. success can coexist with unavailable/unset fields and does not prove an element is writable, claimable or safe to modify later. claims_freshness is current_session_unverified and claims_refresh_attempted is false: no claim refresh, claim/release, PML, CE/view change or capture occurs. PRMOWN is not recursively inspected; target_claim describes only the requested target. Distinct input aliases remain ordered rows with native duplicate_of_index when resolved to the same element. Duplicate input strings after trimming/case normalization are rejected. Inspect row errors, CE/context identity and native_database_fault; partial rows and not_attempted fields remain explicit. Requires no command permission; this observation is not a database lock or authorization for a future operation.

refnos.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element references in result order; current CE is never implicit.

tools.name: e3d_measure_elements_batch
tools.description: Read spatial coordinates, native bounds and/or native gross/net volume for 1 to 32 explicit elements in one E3D UI callback. This reduces inter-call drift without a database lock. Inspect each row and measurement's availability, completeness and read errors; failed rows retain partial values. Spatial PAVE reads can have success=true and complete=false because ORI is unsupported. Bounds retain the SDK native (unverified) coordinate frame and are not implicitly WORLD. Does not select CE, change the view or execute PML.

refnos.description: Unique explicit /NAME or =database/element references, in result order.

wrt.description: Spatial frame: WORLD, OWNER, /NAME or =database/element. Does not relabel bounds.

tools.name: e3d_element_schema
tools.description: Inspect the current E3D element's legal child/owner types and attribute metadata without executing PML. expected_type requires the resolved type to match; the only cross-type alias resolution supported is implicit TUBI from its shared BRAN/ELBO numeric DBREF. The result reports the resolved type. Reports supported attributes, SDK data types, unit categories, current settable state, and direct-editor permission. Empty attributes lists the SDK's attributes in pages; named attributes allow explicit probing, including pseudo-attributes. include_constraints=true additionally reads allowed values/descriptions, raw range boundaries and values-or-ranges optionality for 1 to 10 explicit attributes and an explicit refno. Range units and boundary encoding are unverified. Per-attribute output is capped at 100 values/boundaries and 1024 UTF-16 characters per text; SDK arrays are materialized before these output limits. Unsupported or unknown attributes are findings; read_errors indicate failed inspection. Readability/settable state and returned constraints do not prove that a particular value or create command will succeed.

refno.description: Element /NAME or =database/element; empty selects the current element.

expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName, e.g. TUBI. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO numeric DBREF; other mismatches fail.

attributes.description: Attribute names to inspect, e.g. POS, HEIG, OWNER. Empty lists native SDK attributes, sorted by name.

include_constraints.description: Read native allowed values/ranges and optionality. Requires explicit refno and 1 to 10 distinct named attributes; false preserves ordinary schema reads.

tools.name: e3d_nozzle_orientation_drawing
tools.description: Read explicitly supplied E3D nozzle references and native PPOS/PDIR connection-point data in WORLD coordinates, then build a bounded TOP plan and FRONT elevation orientation drawing. The structured receipt preserves every native response, point availability, position and direction, plus computed horizontal bearing and tilt when PDIR is finite. A PNG preview is always returned for complete geometry; include_svg and include_dxf optionally add vector exports with PDIR arrowheads drawn as feature lines rather than equipment outlines. Optional sheet creates paged A3/A4 landscape sheets with matching point IDs, leader labels and a WORLD coordinate/bearing/tilt schedule; each page uses one model-to-paper scale for both views. Sheets admit up to 128 points, with a total preview budget of 8000000 pixels. Incomplete or unavailable native geometry returns evidence without a partial image or vector drawing. It never infers DN, connection compatibility, catalogue data or engineering validity, and it never traverses the model automatically. The tool does not modify the model, CE, Drawlist, camera or view.

refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element nozzle reference.

point_numbers.description: Optional native P-point numbers; empty discovers supported PPLS entries.

include_svg.description: Include TOP/FRONT vector SVG in the structured drawing.

include_dxf.description: Include ASCII DXF R2000 vector output for complete native point data; dimension annotations are omitted because the drawing is a nozzle-point layout, not an equipment envelope.

sheet.description: Optional printable point-orientation sheets; omitting this preserves the existing bare-view output.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_layout_drawing
tools.description: Read up to 256 explicitly referenced equipment elements in WORLD coordinates in batches of 32 and generate a read-only FRONT/TOP/SIDE equipment pose layout. The drawing uses verified WORLD POS and ORI only: each item is shown by an origin marker and available axis lines labelled X/Y/Z, while native extents are deliberately not invented from an unverified SDK LimitsBox. Only unique, identity-verified rows associated with requested_refno are drawn; missing, duplicate, malformed, unexpected and mismatched rows remain in receipts and make complete=false. When some requested positions are available, the structured result and PNG/SVG are marked partial; DXF requires a complete batch. This is not a shape-outline or dimensioned equipment drawing. It does not traverse automatically, modify the model, select CE, add Drawlist members or change camera/view.

refnos.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element references in layout order.

axis_length_mm.description: World millimetres used for local-axis glyphs.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_layout_sheet
tools.description: Read 1 to 256 explicit WORLD element origins and local orientations in batches of 32 and generate complete A3/A4 TOP/FRONT equipment location sheets. Stable E001 IDs, source references, leaders and signed DX/DY/DEL schedules share one datum, global bounds and position scale across all pages. Default datum is WORLD origin; +Y is not assumed to be plant north. Pose symbols have fixed paper sizes and are not equipment outlines or footprints. Only complete identity-verified native sources and matching session/project/MDB boundary observations produce sheets; observations are sequential, not an atomic snapshot. Returns one PNG per page and optional paper-mm SVG/DXF. Limits: 8 or 16 items per page, 8M total preview pixels, 8 MiB structured output and 8 MiB combined PNG bytes; any page, export or budget failure suppresses all page images. No automatic traversal, native Draft creation, model, CE, Drawlist or camera changes.

label.description: ASCII datum label; does not certify an equipment centre or axis.

origin_mm.description: Explicit WORLD X/Y/Z datum in millimetres.

tools.name: e3d_nozzle_datum_sheet
tools.description: Read 1 to 32 explicit nozzle references and native WORLD PPOS/PDIR, then generate A3/A4 TOP/FRONT orientation sheets relative to a required user-declared WORLD datum. Stable N001 IDs and signed DX/DY/DEL schedules preserve full original WORLD coordinates and directions. All pages share one position scale and global bounds. PDIR bearing remains WORLD +Y toward +X and tilt toward +Z; a datum is not a verified equipment centre, radial nozzle angle or equipment axis. Requires complete native point data, verified source identity and WORLD frame, and matching session/project/MDB boundary observations. Up to 128 points, 8 or 16 per page; 8M total preview pixels, 8 MiB structured output and 8 MiB combined PNG bytes. Returns one PNG per page and optional paper-mm SVG/DXF; any failure suppresses all page images. Does not infer shape, DN, connection validity, traverse automatically, create native Draft or change model, CE, Drawlist or camera.

label.description: ASCII datum label; does not certify an equipment centre or axis.

origin_mm.description: Explicit WORLD X/Y/Z datum in millimetres.

tools.name: e3d_nozzle_axis_sheet
tools.description: Read one explicit EQUI WORLD POS/ORI and 1 to 32 explicit native nozzle PPOS/PDIR sources. Generate A3/A4 radial U/V and axial U/H point sheets around explicitly selected equipment local axial_axis and zero_axis. u is the positive zero axis, n is the positive axial axis and v=n cross u. Position angle is atan2(delta dot v, delta dot u); PDIR azimuth and tilt are separate values. On-axis point angles and axial-direction azimuths are unavailable. Stable point IDs, radius, signed axial offset and two distinct angles preserve original WORLD data and the native equipment frame. All pages share bounds and position scale. The equipment coordinate origin is not certified as a physical centre, and target ownership is not inferred. Requires complete identity-verified EQUI/nozzle data, matching native WORLD frames and session/project/MDB boundary observations. Limits: 128 points, 8/16 per page, 8M total preview pixels, 8 MiB structured output and 8 MiB combined PNG. Any failure suppresses every sheet image. No model, CE, Drawlist, camera, restart or native Draft writes.

zero_axis.description: Positive local zero-angle axis, distinct from axial_axis.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_outline_sheet
tools.description: Read 1 to 16 explicit EQUI groups and a total of 1 to 128 selected typed material sources. Verify each resolved source is a native descendant of its assigned EQUI using bounded paged hierarchy observations, then project all material once with global TOP visibility and render one A3/A4 equipment layout sheet. Shows selected parameter geometry, equipment-origin IDs/leaders and WORLD XYZ plus signed DX/DY/DEL location schedules at one shared scale. A3/A4 landscape; explicit scale optional, otherwise fits. Every equipment requires at least one nonempty admitted source. This does not certify whole-equipment geometry, a native footprint, inter-source Boolean union or native cut application scope. A4 can reject dense 16-equipment layouts instead of dropping labels. Hierarchy proof is capped at 8 pages of up to 200 returned nodes per equipment; source reads remain sequential observations, not an atomic snapshot. Limits: 10k vertices/20k triangles, 2M preview pixels, 8 MiB structured output and 8 MiB combined PNG. Any context/source/membership/projection/layout/export/budget failure returns no sheet images. No automatic geometry selection, native Draft, model, CE, Drawlist or camera writes.

label.description: ASCII datum label; does not certify an equipment centre or axis.

origin_mm.description: Explicit WORLD X/Y/Z datum in millimetres.

tools.name: e3d_equipment_layout_tiles
tools.description: Generate fixed-scale A3/A4 TOP equipment layout tiles from 1 to 64 explicit EQUI groups and at most 128 selected typed material sources. Requires sheet.scale_denominator. Reads and verifies complete WORLD EQUI poses, selected material and bounded native descendant ownership. Projects all sources once with global visibility, then clips one contiguous overlapping grid; never reprojects or reclassifies per page. Grid bounds include geometry and every equipment POS, with stable E001 IDs and per-page WORLD XYZ/DX/DY/DEL schedules. Devices whose geometry crosses a page but whose POS lies outside are explicitly marked without a false origin leader. At most 16 related devices per page; dense pages fail. Preserves source/edge/visibility and exact input-line interval coverage, page coordinates and neighbors. Selected parameter geometry only, not whole-equipment geometry, certified footprint, native cut scope, union or native Draft. Limits: 24 pages, 10k vertices/20k triangles, 20k global lines/40k fragments, 8M total preview pixels and 8 MiB each structured/PNG output. Any failure suppresses all page images. Read-only; no model, CE, Drawlist, camera or restart changes.

label.description: ASCII datum label; does not certify an equipment centre or axis.

origin_mm.description: Explicit WORLD X/Y/Z datum in millimetres.

chord_tolerance_mm.description: Optional maximum analytic operand surface deviation in model millimetres. Refines each curved parent and cutter separately, using radial_segments as a minimum. Impossible tolerance or geometry budget fails without partial geometry. Does not certify native tessellation or Boolean intersection accuracy.

use_generated_dishes.description: Opt into the audited E3D21 Design BasicDIS profile mapping for selected standalone DISH sources. Combines native database dimensions and branch semantics with matching generated-CSG markers and WORLD transforms. Generic catalogue CSG_DISH decoding is unsupported. Requires stable observations; unresolved shapes fail without a drawing. Other sources retain their declared mode.

tools.name: e3d_nozzle_outline_sheet
tools.description: Generate equipment-local radial U/V and axial U/H nozzle orientation sheets with selected parameter equipment outlines. Requires one explicit EQUI, 1 to 32 native nozzle targets, distinct positive local axial_axis/zero_axis and 1 to 128 typed material sources. Verifies source membership under the equipment, complete native WORLD poses/points and agreeing session/project/MDB boundaries. WORLD mesh coordinates/hash are preserved; projections use u=zero axis, n=axial axis, v=n cross u, radial (u,v,n) and axial (u,n,-v), with joint depth visibility across all selected sources. Uses one common scale/bounds including outlines, points and native POS; distinguishes point position angle from PDIR azimuth/tilt. Axial PDIR azimuth and zero-radius position angles are NA. Returns A3/A4 sheets with one PNG per page and optional paper-mm SVG/DXF. Selected geometry does not certify complete equipment, native tessellation/cut scope, physical centerline or nozzle ownership. 128 points, 8/16 per page, 10k vertices/20k triangles, 8M preview pixels, 8 MiB structured and PNG totals; any failure suppresses every image. Read-only, no native Draft, model, CE, Drawlist, camera or restart writes.

nozzle_geometry.description: catalogue reads and verifies a supported coaxial SCYL flange/neck GMSE and PTAX pair, drawing actual catalogue outside diameters and a single label per nozzle. Unsupported catalogues fail explicitly. Base material only; insulation and bore/wall geometry are not inferred. points retains the diagnostic P-point presentation.

scale_denominator.description: Optional fixed model-to-paper scale 1:N for catalogue geometry. Omit for a fitting engineering scale; explicit scales fail if they do not fit.

chord_tolerance_mm.description: Optional maximum analytic operand surface deviation in model millimetres. Refines each curved parent and cutter separately, using radial_segments as a minimum. Impossible tolerance or geometry budget fails without partial geometry. Does not certify native tessellation or Boolean intersection accuracy.

use_generated_dishes.description: Opt into the audited E3D21 Design BasicDIS profile mapping for selected standalone DISH sources. Combines native database dimensions and branch semantics with matching generated-CSG markers and WORLD transforms. Generic catalogue CSG_DISH decoding is unsupported. Requires stable observations; unresolved shapes fail without a drawing. Other sources retain their declared mode.

tools.name: e3d_connection_points
tools.description: Read actual E3D connection points for one explicit element in WORLD, OWNER or an explicit reference frame. An omitted/empty point_numbers discovers and reads up to 64 native PPLS point numbers; it never assumes contiguous numbering. Explicit point numbers require native existence evidence before indexed reads. Returns per-field availability for PPOS position, PDIR direction, PPBO bore in mm, PPCO connection type and raw PCREF encoding, plus catalogue/connection references. Inspect enumeration, complete and errors; unknown PPLS membership stays null and negative point numbers decode by absolute value. PCREF type 710633 preserves its anchor and resolves the fixed 'ILEAVE TUBE OF =database/element' PML1 reference expression through the Database SDK; only a TUBI result is marked resolved. A zero native bore is not DN0. Element POS, HEIG and ORI are not substituted for connection geometry. Read completeness does not establish suitability for connection, flange rating or catalogue compatibility. Does not dispatch PML commands, edit geometry, select CE, add display members or change the view.

refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference.

expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO anchor; other mismatches fail.

tools.name: e3d_check_connection_pair
tools.description: Read and compare two explicitly selected E3D P-points in one native E3D21 UI-thread dispatch. Requires both explicit element references, both point numbers and a caller-supplied position tolerance in mm. Optional first_expected_type and second_expected_type constrain each resolved endpoint to a Design type ShortName; only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO anchor. Reports each point's existence and read completeness, position delta against that tolerance, native PDIR direction dot product and angle, and each PCREF's resolution and exact correspondence to the opposite selected endpoint. Direction labels use a descriptive plus/minus 0.999 dot threshold, not an engineering rule. Preserves native PPBO bore, PPCO connection type, raw PCREF data and SPRE/CATR/CREF catalogue/connection reference evidence. Unknown or partial reads remain unknown; native evidence is not a dimensional, pressure-class, catalogue or engineering compatibility verdict. Does not dispatch PML commands, edit geometry, select CE, add display members or change the view.

first_refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference for the first element.

first_expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName for the first element. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO anchor; other mismatches fail.

second_refno.description: Required explicit /NAME or =database/element reference for the second element.

second_expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName for the second element. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO anchor; other mismatches fail.

tolerance_mm.description: Required finite position tolerance in millimetres; no default is applied.

tools.name: e3d_trace_piping_connectivity
tools.description: Trace directed native PCREF links from 1 to 16 explicit P-point starts in one E3D21 UI dispatch. Reads P-point existence, PCREF and element identity only; it does not read geometry or catalogue fields. Follows fully resolved element, type and point references within max_hops and max_nodes. An optional expected_type uses the SDK type ShortName and requires the start type to match; the only cross-type exception is implicit TUBI sharing a numeric DBREF with its BRAN/ELBO anchor. Reports endpoint and reference evidence, open ends, unresolved references, reciprocal/one-way/unknown direction, observed cycles, truncation and context changes separately. Unknown PCREF reads are never treated as open ends or disconnected. This is a database-reference trace, not a geometric proximity or engineering compatibility verdict; one UI callback is not a database lock.

refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element reference.

expected_type.description: Optional required Design type ShortName. Only implicit TUBI has cross-type resolution from a shared BRAN/ELBO anchor; other mismatches fail.

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of unique endpoints to inspect; must be at least the number of starts.

tools.name: e3d_spatial_info
tools.description: Read numeric POS and ORI through the E3D SDK with an explicit reference frame. Returns millimetres and local axis vectors in WORLD, OWNER, or a named/DBREF frame. Check position_complete and orientation_complete independently; complete requires both. A PAVE can have success=true, position_complete=true, orientation_complete=false and complete=false because ORI is unsupported. For position checks, verify position_complete, refno, frame and errors; do not require ORI. Unsupported attributes are not read errors; SDK failures retain other available fields and set success=false. Does not change the current element or view.

refno.description: Element name /NAME or numeric =database/element; empty selects the current element.

wrt.description: Reference frame: WORLD, OWNER, /NAME, or =database/element. Coordinates are relative to this frame, not implicitly the parent.

tools.name: e3d_transform_coordinates
tools.description: Convert up to 128 points and 128 direction vectors between explicit E3D reference frames in one native UI dispatch. Frames are WORLD, /NAME or =database/element; coordinates and point origins use millimetres. The SDK reads frame POS/ORI relative to WORLD; conversion fails closed for missing orientation, non-finite or non-orthonormal axes, unavailable frames, or changed CE/project/MDB context. Points include translation; direction vectors do not. Inspect success, complete, read_errors and context identity. A single UI dispatch is not a database lock. Mock mode and non-E3D21 versions report unavailable without fabricated conversions.

points.description: Point coordinates in mm; each is [x,y,z].

vectors.description: Direction vectors, each [x,y,z]; no translation is applied.

tools.name: e3d_graphical_selection
tools.description: Read the native graphical interaction selection with bounded element details. Its scope is the native interaction selection; membership is not guaranteed to belong to the current view and does not establish tree selection, every highlighted element or the last picked item. Inspect availability, completeness, truncation and read errors; unknown or failed reads do not establish an empty selection. Does not select CE, modify the selection or change the view.

tools.name: e3d_set_graphical_selection
tools.description: Preview or replace the native graphical interaction selection with 0 to 32 explicit numeric references; an empty refnos list clears it. Targets must already exist as exact Drawlist members or primitive entries. Never Add graphics, promote owners, expand children, change CE or fit the camera. Preview defaults to true and requires a complete current selection of at most 200 entries and complete display maps. Execute with its 64-hex revision as expected_revision and command permission. The revision binds session/context, current CE, complete ordered original selection, requested references and display state; it is not a lock. A same-set no-op preserves native order and skips all setters, notification and update. Actual writes use addGraphics=false and are checked in a separate UI callback. Inspect readback_verified, verification_state, ce_unchanged, context_unchanged and display_unchanged; set equality and order agreement are separate observations. Void native returns or update completion alone do not prove success. Failures may leave partial selection; no automatic rollback, replay, cancellation or image capture. Mock cannot simulate a native result.

refnos.description: Explicit numeric =database/element identities; [] means clear. Normalized duplicate identities are rejected.

tools.name: e3d_delete_element
tools.description: Preview or delete an E3D element through the database API without invoking the interactive DELETE CE command. Execution is successful only when the native receipt confirms the exact numeric DBREF is deleted and the complete original owner's ordered membership matches that same member removed. Inspect native_delete_returned, verification_status, deletion_verified, readback_deleted_state, readback_absent_from_owner and readback_owner_membership_matches_expected. Incomplete or uncertain readback is an MCP error with retry_safe=false; do not replay it. Older add-in responses lacking this evidence fail closed and skip image capture.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_set_attribute
tools.description: Preview or update a restricted E3D attribute directly through the SDK. Both paths check attribute support, current settable state and input type; numeric input must be finite, with dot decimal notation. Preview does not prove all value/database constraints. Use e3d_element_schema for permitted attributes and inspect returned write_attempted/write_applied after failures.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_set_attributes
tools.description: Preview or set 1 to 20 restricted attributes on one explicit E3D element in a single UI dispatch. Keys use the same direct-edit whitelist as e3d_set_attribute; all values are strings and numeric values use finite invariant notation. Preview validates the full request before writing and returns a revision bound to the target, requested values, original values and session/project/MDB. Execute the same request with expected_revision from that preview. Fields are applied sequentially and read back individually; this is not an atomic transaction, and a failure can leave earlier fields changed. Inspect per-field status, write/readback and residual observations, then read the element before deciding what to do. No automatic rollback or replay.

refno.description: Explicit /NAME or =database/element reference.

values.description: One to 20 unique attributes from NAME, DESC, DUTY, DIAM, HEIG, XLEN, YLEN, ZLEN, DTOP and DBOT. Numeric values are strings in finite invariant notation. Names are trimmed and uppercased; case/space variants of the same attribute are duplicates.

expected_revision.description: Revision returned by previewing the same target and values. Required for execution.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_execute_pml
tools.description: Preview or execute a PML command. dry_run=true checks input without proving valid PML or executing it. Adapters advertising pml_nested_scope run ordinary requests in independent nested scopes; inspect execution_scope and errors. Use e3d_execute_pml_script for complete scripts with IF/DO blocks. Local ! variables are not shared across requests. Real execution requires dry_run=false and E3D_MCP_ALLOW_COMMANDS=true.

command.description: PML command to validate or execute

expected_session_id.description: Optional session_id from e3d_status. A supporting adapter rejects the command if the E3D session has changed (api_features includes command_session_guard).

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_execute_pml_script
tools.description: Preview or execute a complete PML script, including IF/DO blocks, via an adapter-owned temporary macro in an independent nested scope. source must be non-empty valid Unicode, contain no NUL and occupy at most 262144 strict UTF-8 bytes; source formatting is preserved. dry_run=true validates input and the running E3D code-page encoding only: it creates no file, performs no execution and does not check syntax. Real execution requires dry_run=false and E3D_MCP_ALLOW_COMMANDS=true. Inspect execution_attempted/completed, native_run_returned, outcome_uncertain, error_metadata and cleanup; failures can leave partially executed effects, with no rollback or automatic retry. The receipt has no submitted source/command field; native output and errors may contain printed values or source excerpts and are not redacted. Execution assigns a UUID request_id when omitted and reads /health for a session guard when expected_session_id is omitted; no script is submitted without a session. A transport timeout or disconnection retains outcome_uncertain=true, retry_safe=false and pml_script_request identifiers; it does not automatically inspect command state, cancel, read messages or resend the script. Use e3d_pml_script_status to look up an uncertain request. A request_id can be accepted only once per session; never replay an uncertain script with a new ID. byte_count/source_sha256 describe original UTF-8 source; encoding.byte_count describes the actual macro bytes and reports any terminal newline added. Local ! variables stay within this script; !! globals are session state. capture_after returns an image only after confirmed success.

source.description: Complete source, preserved verbatim; non-whitespace, no NUL or invalid Unicode, at most 262144 UTF-8 bytes. The running E3D code page may reject characters that UTF-8 accepts.

request_id.description: Optional canonical UUID (any version), normalized to lowercase. Generated for real execution if omitted. Preview only validates it and creates no receipt.

expected_session_id.description: Optional session_id from e3d_status; a mismatch rejects the script before execution. Real execution reads /health first when omitted.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_pml_script_status
tools.description: Read a complete PML script request's in-memory receipt without executing, cancelling or capturing anything. Requires the original request_id and expected_session_id; a different session rejects the lookup. Inspect available, status (pending/completed/unknown_or_expired), receipt_available and the receipt's original envelope/http_status or size-limit summary. A completed lookup can contain a failed script receipt; inspect that original result separately. pending does not prove the SDK began executing; unknown_or_expired does not prove the script never executed, even when no receipt remains. At most 64 receipts are retained, completed receipts expire after 30 minutes, and all records disappear when the E3D session ends. Accepted IDs remain reserved for the session even after receipt expiry/eviction; request_id_reserved reports this when available. Duplicate IDs are rejected without re-execution. Up to 65536 accepted IDs are reserved; a full store rejects new execution. Never automatically replay an uncertain script.

request_id.description: Original script request UUID in 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal format; any version, normalized to lowercase.

expected_session_id.description: Original E3D session_id; never substitute a newer session after a restart.

tools.name: e3d_reenter_design
tools.description: Debug restart: require successful SAVEWORK, send DESIGN once, then confirm a new session with the original project and MDB. Reuses the E3D login. On a readiness timeout inspect status/project; do not automatically resend DESIGN. Does not restore the view.

wait_seconds.description: Readiness polling budget after the single DESIGN request; individual HTTP requests may add their timeout.

tools.name: e3d_execute_pml_batch
