tools.description: Execute a sequence of PML commands through the E3D UI thread. Each command is reported separately and the batch stops on the first error by default.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_create_element
tools.description: Create a child through the E3D SDK under an explicit parent, with optional dimensions/text and transform. Preview validates type/owner compatibility and inputs without creating anything; it returns a revision when the connected E3D21 bridge supports guarded execution. Pass that revision as expected_revision when executing so a changed parent, frame or request is rejected before creation. Older preview calls remain compatible. Preview does not prove all database constraints. A failed initialization attempts to remove only the new element; inspect cleanup and residual state before retrying.

expected_revision.description: Revision returned by a create preview. The E3D21 bridge requires it for guarded execution; omitted previews remain valid.

position.description: Position in millimetres in the wrt frame.

orientation.description: Local X and Y axes as unit, orthogonal vectors in the wrt frame; Z is their cross product.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_copy_element
tools.description: Copy supported native geometry through one guarded SDK operation under an explicit destination parent and new /NAME. Preview first and execute with its revision as expected_revision; inspect the source-to-copy mapping and native readback. Supports CYLI, BOX and CONE with leaf NCYL, NBOX and NCON cuts, positive standard DISH without children, plus bounded SUBE trees containing these and simple PANE/PLOO/PAVE geometry, up to 2048 nodes and depth 32. DISH copying preserves DIAM, HEIG and stored RADI, and its origin remains the base circle centre. DISH with any children and NDIS are unsupported. Whole EQUI equipment, rules, links and UDET types are unsupported. Named descendants receive the new root name plus -C and their depth-first sequence number; unnamed descendants remain unnamed. Omitted position and orientation independently preserve the source WORLD components; supplied components use wrt, whose OWNER is the destination parent. Native inspection decides eligibility and name collisions. A failed copy attempts cleanup of only its new subtree; inspect cleanup and actual residual state before retrying. This is not an atomic database transaction. Does not select CE, add to the Drawlist, or fit the camera. Never automatically replay a copy to obtain an image.

name.description: Required new root /NAME, at most 50 characters including slash, without whitespace or control characters. Native preflight requires at most 44 when named descendants need the six-character -C0001 suffix; anonymous descendants need no suffix. Names are never truncated.

position.description: Position in millimetres in wrt; omit to preserve the source WORLD position.

orientation.description: Unit orthogonal X/Y axes in wrt; omit to preserve the source WORLD orientation.

wrt.description: OWNER means the destination parent; otherwise WORLD, /NAME or =database/element.

expected_revision.description: Revision from copy preview. Required for execution; may be omitted for preview.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_create_panel
tools.description: Create a native PANE with one PLOO and 3 to 256 straight PAVE vertices through one SDK operation under an explicit parent. Vertices are local XY millimetres, simple and counterclockwise, without a repeated closing vertex or holes; thickness is positive millimetres. Position and orientation default to the origin and identity in the wrt frame. Preview performs native validation without writing. A failed creation attempts to remove only its new subtree; inspect cleanup and residual state before retrying. This is not an atomic database transaction. The adapter does not explicitly add to the Drawlist or fit a view; E3D creation notifications may display new geometry.

vertices.description: Local [x,y] vertices in millimetres, counterclockwise with no closing repeat.

justification.description: Thickness extends along local +Z, symmetrically about XY, or along local -Z.

position.description: Position in millimetres in the wrt frame.

orientation.description: Local X and Y axes as unit, orthogonal vectors in the wrt frame; Z is their cross product.

capture_after.description: After a confirmed successful operation, return a native E3D image receipt.

tools.name: e3d_panel_geometry
tools.description: Read an explicitly referenced PANE's native PLOO/PAVE geometry, local XYZ vertices, thickness, justification, polygon findings and revision token for guarded updates. Does not use or select the current element. Native inspection is bounded at 32 loops and 2048 vertices; inspect complete, partial/read errors and validation availability before interpreting the result. Optional include_world reads each PAVE's native control-point POS in the current MDB Design WORLD and reports independent world_positions_complete/world_read_errors. Optional include_boundary reads raw native P0/P4/P6/P8 geometry points for nonzero-FRAD PAVEs, with P0 direction and explicit PANE-local coordinates; include_world also requests independent WORLD boundary-point reads. Inspect boundary_points_complete/errors separately. These optional reads do not change local completeness/topology and do not assemble arcs, resolve thickness or return a rendered outline.

refno.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or =database/element reference; current element is never implicit.

include_world.description: Also read each PAVE native control-point position in the current MDB Design WORLD, with separate completeness and errors.

include_boundary.description: Also inspect raw native P0/P4/P6/P8 geometry points for nonzero-FRAD PAVEs; optional WORLD evidence follows include_world. No curve or thickness inference.

tools.name: e3d_panel_mesh
tools.description: Read one explicitly referenced PANE and derive a closed prism mesh from one complete, valid, straight loop and its native HEIG/SJUS parameters. Supports documented BOTT, CENT, TOP and BOTTOM justification tokens only. coordinate_space defaults to panel_local; WORLD uses one native read of all PAVE WORLD positions and accepts only a validated right-handed orthonormal panel frame with consistent rigid-transform residuals. Multiple loops, blind loops, fillets, incomplete geometry or invalid WORLD transforms are rejected. This is parameter-derived geometry, not E3D tessellation, CSG or rendered geometry; no model, current element, Drawlist or camera changes are made.

refno.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or =database/element reference; current element is never implicit.

coordinate_space.description: Output coordinate frame; WORLD requires complete native PAVE WORLD positions.

tools.name: e3d_project_panel_boundary_drawing
tools.description: Read one explicitly referenced native PANE and project the native PAVE control-point loops directly into FRONT/TOP/SIDE views. This route does not derive a prism mesh, does not require HEIG/SJUS, and does not infer outer/inner loops, holes, thickness, visibility or Boolean cuts. WORLD requires complete native PAVE WORLD positions; incomplete loops or point reads fail closed. Returns a PNG preview and optional SVG/DXF control-polygon linework with explicit limitations. It never changes the model, current element, Drawlist, camera or view.

refno.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or =database/element reference.

coordinate_space.description: Use native PAVE WORLD control points, or PANE-local PAVE positions.

tools.name: e3d_panel_curve_boundary
tools.description: Read an explicit PANE, check native DESP import descriptors, and derive validated straight/positive-fillet curves in its definition plane from native P0/P4/P6/P8. Returns line/arc segments and bounded chord samples, preserving independent PPEXST unknowns and native completeness. Supports eligible ordinary convex/concave fillets; unsupported tags, curve types, ambiguous arcs, inconsistent frames, crossing boundaries or changed observations return no boundary. WORLD requires independently observed native WORLD points and a validated rigid frame. Separate reads are compared and bracketed by session/project observations, not an atomic snapshot. No model, CE, Drawlist, camera or view changes; no rendered outline, thickness surface, holes, cuts or visibility is inferred.

refno.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or numeric DBREF; never implicit CE.

chord_tolerance_mm.description: Maximum circular-arc chord sagitta in millimetres; sampling is bounded.

tools.name: e3d_project_panel_curve_drawing
tools.description: Read one explicit PANE and generate FRONT/TOP/SIDE projections of its validated native definition-plane line/arc boundary, with a PNG and optional SVG/DXF. Curve linework is sampled to chord_tolerance_mm; DXF contains sampled LINE entities. This resolves eligible positive fillets instead of drawing their pole control polygon. Import tags, unsupported geometry, failed or changed native reads produce no image. Preserves unknown PPEXST existence separately from available point coordinates. Does not compute thickness surfaces, final rendered/Boolean outlines, holes, hidden lines or occlusion, and never changes the E3D model, CE, Drawlist or camera.

tools.name: e3d_project_panel_curve_assembly_drawing
tools.description: Read 1 to 128 explicit PANE references and compose paged WORLD FRONT/TOP/SIDE drawings of their validated definition-plane line/positive-fillet curves. All pages use identical global view bounds so spatial alignment and display scale remain comparable across pages. Each line retains its global source index and PANE reference; curves are sampled to chord_tolerance_mm, with optional SVG and 1:1 millimetre DXF LINE exports. Every source uses native boundary points and checked DESP descriptors, with whole-operation session/project observations in addition to per-source consistency checks. Unsupported or incomplete geometry, duplicate resolved identities, frame changes or resource limits return no image. Separate reads are not an atomic snapshot. This is independent definition-curve composition: no cross-panel Boolean union, thickness surfaces, hole roles, hidden lines or final rendered equipment outline. Does not change the model, CE, Drawlist, camera or view.

targets.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or numeric DBREF values, in source order.

tools.name: e3d_project_panel_assembly_boundary_drawing
tools.description: Read an explicit list of up to 128 native PANE elements and create paged shared E3D WORLD FRONT/TOP/SIDE views of their PAVE control-point polygons. Defaults to 16 PANE sources per page; choose 32, 64 or 128 for denser grouped pages or a whole-equipment control-polygon overview. Each page returns its own PNG, with optional SVG/DXF, and every line retains global source index and PANE reference. This supports large assemblies even when PANE HEIG/SJUS prevents prism-mesh generation. Every PANE and WORLD PAVE position must be complete and identity-matched, with one identical native WORLD frame across all sources; each source retains its native revision when available. The complete request is bounded to 2048 PAVE points and 12000 projected line segments. This is control-polygon composition only: no shell union, thickness, outer/inner loop, holes, visibility, hidden-line removal, cuts or native tessellation are inferred. Separate native reads and before/after context observations are not an atomic snapshot. Read-only: no model, current element, Drawlist, camera or view changes.

targets.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or =database/element references. Use e3d_find_descendants to collect and paginate the equipment's PANE members first.

panels_per_page.description: Number of explicit PANE sources overlaid per drawing page; controls image density and page count.

tools.name: e3d_panel_loop_relations
tools.description: Read one explicitly referenced PANE and report pairwise geometric relations between its simple, complete, coplanar PLOO polygons in PANE-local XY. Relations distinguish containment, separation, boundary crossings/contacts and unknown pairs. This is a geometry-only result: it does not infer outer/inner loops, holes, cut success or rendered visibility, and it does not upgrade the panel's overall topology_valid verdict. Native panel completeness and per-pair unknown reasons remain explicit. No model, current element, Drawlist or camera changes are made.

refno.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or =database/element reference; current element is never implicit.

tools.name: e3d_update_panel
tools.description: Reshape one explicitly referenced native PANE from 3 to 256 simple counterclockwise local XY vertices, without holes or a repeated closing vertex. Inspect e3d_panel_geometry, preview this update, then execute with expected_revision from the preview and verify readback or an image receipt. Optional thickness and justification preserve their current values when omitted. Retains the PANE, PLOO and existing prefix PAVE references; growth appends vertices, while shrinking requires allow_vertex_deletion=true and preview reports the exact removed references. Deletions are not atomically reversible. Inspect partial, rollback and actual residual state after failure; never automatically replay a write. Does not accept transforms or rename the panel.

refno.description: Explicit PANE /NAME or =database/element reference.

vertices.description: Replacement local [x,y] vertices in millimetres, counterclockwise with no closing repeat.

tools.name: e3d_primitive_geometry
tools.description: Read one explicitly referenced native CYLI, NCYL, BOX, NBOX, CONE, NCON or positive DISH: inspect dimensions, placement, child references, eligibility findings and the revision token before a guarded update. DISH uses DIAM, HEIG and RADI; its base circle is at local z=0, and only a standard DISH without children is eligible for guarded editing. Does not select the current element, write geometry or change the view. Inspect native availability, completeness and read errors before interpreting the result.

refno.description: Explicit primitive /NAME or =database/element reference; current element is never implicit.

tools.name: e3d_generated_csg
tools.description: Read bounded native generated-CSG descriptors for one explicit BOX/CYLI/CONE/DISH/NOZZ/PANE. Returns native item types, raw real/integer parameters, 12-value transforms and untransformed local limits; unknown and negative item types remain explicit. This is an analytic descriptor observation, not native tessellation or a resolved Boolean mesh. Raw units and transform conventions remain unverified. Rejects hierarchy-wide requests. Output budgets do not bound SDK generation time or memory. A native generation failure quarantines further SDK work until a module restart. Does not change the model, current element, Drawlist or camera.

tools.name: e3d_primitive_mesh
tools.description: Read one explicitly referenced primitive and derive a bounded triangle mesh from its native parameters for positive BOX, CYLI, CONE, or a positive DISH with RADI=0. DISH RADI=0 uses a mathematical spherical-cap approximation with its base at local z=0; nonzero RADI is rejected because its native curved surface is not parameterized by the stored value. coordinate_space defaults to primitive_local; WORLD applies the validated native WORLD pose to vertices and normals. This is parameter-derived geometry, not E3D tessellation or rendered/Boolean geometry. Negative primitives, any child geometry, incomplete reads, unsupported shapes, or invalid WORLD frames are rejected. No model, current element, Drawlist or camera changes are made.

tools.description: Read a positive BOX/CYLI/CONE and its 1 to 32 flat leaf NCYL/NBOX/NCON children, then compute their owner-member parameter difference with manifold3d Mesh64 in a bounded 30-second worker. The current native bridge rejects DISH with child members. Output is WORLD millimetres, at most 10,000 vertices/20,000 triangles. Preserves inward cavity shells; fully removed material is successful and empty. Requires the optional geometry dependencies. This is parameter CSG, not native tessellation; native negative-application scope remains unverified. Two matching complete native parameter reads and session/project/MDB boundary observations are required, without an atomic database snapshot. Optional native volume comparison preserves representation-dependent discrepancies and does not verify shape or cut scope. No model, current element, Drawlist, camera or view changes.

This is not an atomic database transaction: inspect actual rollback and residual state after failure, and never automatically replay a write. Does not rename, add to the Drawlist, or fit the camera.

tools.name: e3d_validate_triangle_mesh
tools.description: Validate a caller-supplied indexed triangle mesh without contacting E3D. Checks finite 3D coordinates, integer indices, relative degeneracy, duplicate faces, edge and vertex manifoldness, shared-edge winding, and signed volume per connected component. A valid result does not detect triangle self-intersections and does not certify E3D native CSG, tessellation or rendering.

Returns an axis-aligned bounding box and the sum of supplied triangle areas when all coordinates and indices are finite and measurable. Also includes e3d_validate_triangle_mesh findings; open meshes can be measured but remain valid=false. Coordinates and area units are caller-supplied and never inferred. This does not detect self-intersections or certify E3D CSG, tessellation, engineering validity, or screen visibility.

vertices.description: Indexed [x,y,z] coordinate list; units are caller-supplied.

tools.name: e3d_geometry_overlap_candidates

This is not an exact clash, clearance, or engineering verdict: concavity, holes, negative geometry, and frame differences can change the real result. Bounds are compared as returned; coordinate_frame is SDK native (unverified) and coordinate_comparability is unverified, so validate the frame for the elements being compared before relying on exclusions. A gap equal to tolerance_mm is included; default zero includes touching bounds. Missing or invalid bounds leave affected pairs unknown and make the result incomplete. Reads at most 32 references per group and 1024 pairs, without editing the model or changing CE, Drawlist, or camera.

The current suspension reason takes precedence. dry_run=true reads native references, hierarchy and Design DB identity without querying spatial-map status, creating Clasher objects or running the engine. The following actual-check rules describe the suspended implementation: dry_run=false, E3D_MCP_ALLOW_COMMANDS=true and UPTODATE or NOWARNINGS spatial maps were required for all input Design DBs before any Clasher factory; other statuses reject spatial_map_not_accepted. Inspect input_spatial_maps_accepted, per-database accepted and spatial_map_admission_policy; input_spatial_maps_up_to_date and per-database up_to_date remain exact UPTODATE checks. The experimental NOWARNINGS policy follows a local E3D21 single-DB MAP CHECK with zero discrepancies while SDK status remained NOWARNINGS; neither acceptance nor that observation alone proves correct geometry classification. After input-database admission and explicit bounded scope validation, actual execution sets and verifies options.override=true. Read override_policy: this may bypass unrelated current-MDB map warnings, which remain in the receipt, without building maps. A local PML comparison returned error (69,85) with OVERRIDE OFF and one clash for the same EQUI pair with OVERRIDE ON. A subsequent isolated EQUI/BOX SDK positive fixture returned one HH clash with verified BOX endpoints; broader geometry_classification_verified remains false, including unvalidated CYLI/CONE, negative cuts and general units/frames. Prior Check=true with four empty arrays does not prove geometry was computed or establish a valid negative result. CheckSpatialMap resolves databases by Number only, without verified ExtractNumber targeting. Inputs with Db.IsExtract=true remain preview-only and actual checks reject unsupported_spatial_map_extract_scope even when their map status is accepted. Use the native is_extract flag, not extract_number!=0: a primary database may have extract_number=1. Inspect spatial_map_database_resolution and spatial_map_extract_targeting_verified. Execution changes native global diagnostic settings: obstruction and touch-overlap changes have been observed. Full diagnostic state is not automatically restored; this is not a read-only operation.
